svg.title: Microsoft Sentinel detection lab – architecture
svg.desc: Three data sources feed a Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel. Four KQL analytics rules create incidents, and a Logic App playbook emails the analyst. Everything is deployed from GitHub with GitHub Actions using OIDC.
svg.text: Infrastructure and detections are defined as code in this repository and deployed by GitHub Actions
